reviews.shade: Abib Collagen Eye Cream Jericho Rose Tube 30mL
reviews.text: I don’t see quick result! I also developed write spots around the eyes. It a bit to rich for me!
reviews.zh: 唔見到快速見效！眼周仲多咗白斑。對我嚟講有少少太rich！

reviews.shade: Abib Collagen Eye Cream Jericho Rose Tube 30mL
reviews.text: My dark circles seem lighter recently, but I'm not sure if it is because of this product. It is moisturizing but not greasy, and it does not cause irritation or milia. It works well for my 37-year-old under-eye skin. I also like the bottle design, as it is easy to control the amount each time.
reviews.zh: 我嘅黑眼圈近排睇落淡咗，但唔肯定係咪因為呢件產品。佢保濕得嚟唔油笠，亦都唔會刺激或者生油脂粒。對我37歲嘅眼周皮膚好有效。我仲好鍾意支樽嘅設計，每次都好容易控制用量。

reviews.shade: Abib Collagen Eye Cream Jericho Rose Tube 30mL
reviews.text: This eye cream is moisturizing and no-irritating. It is mild and with no-scent. I use it before make up and the performance is not bad. I hope it could also help to reduce my redness and darkness around my eyes.
reviews.zh: 呢支眼霜保濕又唔刺激。性質溫和而且冇香味。我喺化妝前用，效果唔錯。希望佢可以進一步幫我減淡眼周嘅泛紅同暗沉。

reviews.shade: Abib Collagen Eye Cream Jericho Rose Tube 30mL
reviews.text: I’ve repurchased this eye cream 2-3 times now, it is by far one of the best eye creams. I prefer a slight thicker eye cream so the consistency is perfect, but it’s not so thick I can’t use it during the day. It keeps the under eye and corners of the eyes hydrated and firm
reviews.zh: 呢支眼霜我已經回購咗2-3次，係到目前為止最好用嘅眼霜之一。我鍾意杰少少嘅眼霜，所以呢個質地啱啱好，但又唔會杰到令日間用唔到。可以keep住眼底同眼尾肌膚保濕同緊緻。

reviews.shade: Abib Collagen Eye Cream Jericho Rose Tube 30mL
reviews.text: Just started using it so haven’t seen any results yet, but I really like that this eye cream doesn’t have any scent and it absorbs very well to my skin. It also feels very hydrating! And the amount is perfect
reviews.zh: 啱啱開始用，所以仲未見到效果，但真係好鍾意呢支眼霜冇香味，而且好快就吸收到皮膚入面。感覺都好保濕！容量亦都啱啱好。

reviews.shade: Abib Collagen Eye Cream Jericho Rose Tube 30mL
reviews.text: Esta es la segunda vez que lo compró. Me ha ayudado con el tema de hidratación y evitar ligeras líneas de expresión tanto en la zona de ojos como zona nasofacial. Lo uso como parte de mi rutina de día
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第二次買。佢幫到我保濕同避免眼周同鼻翼附近出現細紋。我會當係日間routine一部分嚟用。

reviews.shade: Abib Collagen Eye Cream Jericho Rose Tube 30mL
reviews.text: This eye cream is light yet deeply hydrating. It melts into the skin without feeling greasy, & my under-eye area looks plumper & brighter. The mix of collagen, bakuchiol & caffeine is supposed to help with fine lines & puffiness – these are very good ingredients. A little goes a long way, & I love the soothing feel it provides. If you want to try something gentle but effective, this is a great pick! 💖
reviews.zh: 呢款眼霜質地輕盈但深層保濕。搽上面會自然融入皮膚，唔會有油笠感，眼底肌膚望落更飽滿提亮。混合咗膠原蛋白、補骨脂酚同咖啡因，聲稱有助改善細紋同浮腫——呢啲都係非常好嘅成分。少量已經夠用，舒緩感覺我好鍾意。如果你想試溫和但有效嘅產品，呢款係唔錯嘅選擇！💖

reviews.shade: Abib Collagen Eye Cream Jericho Rose Tube 30mL
reviews.text: I’ll definitely purchase this cream again. I have very sensitive skin/eczema type skin around my eyes and this is the first crean than not only not irritates my skin also treat my dryness and wrinkles. 100% recommended.
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜我一定會回購。我眼周皮膚屬於非常敏感/濕疹型，呢款係第一款不但冇刺激到我皮膚，仲改善咗乾燥同皺紋嘅產品。100% 推薦。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
